responsibility: Defines the public, compiler-agnostic Stable MIR surface and the bridge used to query it from an active compiler context. At the top level it provides stable crate/item identity types, queries for crates and MIR-bearing items, the `Context` trait, and thread-local dispatch into the backend; within that API it exposes the MIR-specific submodule as the entry point for MIR functionality; and through the body representation it provides the stable data model for function bodies, including control-flow structure, statements, terminators, places, operands, and rvalues, so tools can inspect item MIR without depending on rustc internals.
